title: Track Unity Gateway skill usage with audit logs and the usage dashboard
body: You can now track usage of Unity Gateway Skills, which are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). [Audit logs](/aws/en/admin/account-settings/audit-logs#ai-gateway-skills) record skill list, load, and file fetch events under the `aiGatewaySkills` service. The **Skills** tab of the [usage dashboard](/aws/en/ai-gateway/usage-tracking#view-usage-dashboard) shows downloads, loads, and activity by user.
